report:
Fresh review of the current claim and all evidence printed by review start. The complete requirement set is: (1) recursive semantics depend on canonical cycles rather than polling order; (2) repeated canonical goals have distinct explicit inductive, coinductive, and unknown path semantics; (3) provisional results participate in fixpoint evaluation; (4) infinitely growing distinct goals are overflow governed by deterministic structural limits and are not treated as ordinary repeated-goal cycles. The current inventory has exactly one implementation entry and one test, both explicitly TODO in sage_meta::todo, with no ordinary or N/A entry.
The implementation TODO explicitly says the provisional inductive cutoff and depth limit do not implement path-kind-aware canonical-cycle fixpoints. This adequately identifies the missing mechanism underlying requirements 1 through 3 and does not present a simple cutoff as satisfying them. Its depth-limit qualification is not evidence that the stronger deterministic structural-limit contract in requirement 4 is implemented. That obligation remains deferred together with this entry. No production implementation is associated or certified by this review.
The entire associated solver_canonical_cycles test contains comments only, with no behavioral assertion. Its planned matrix distinguishes inductive failure, coinductive success, unknown-path ambiguity, converging/non-converging fixpoints, non-repeating growth overflow, and ready-queue perturbation invariance. That matrix addresses all claim aspects and the important repeated versus distinct-goal boundary. The implementation prerequisite is path-kind-aware canonical-goal cycle tracking and provisional fixpoint evaluation, with deterministic structural resource limits; queue-order testing also needs a fixture that perturbs scheduling of the same recursive clause families. The explicitly deferred test is appropriate until those prerequisites exist. Its passing empty body would provide no behavioral verification, and none is credited here.
Accepted only the existing justified TODO status under the captured review decisions policy. No missing behavior is relabeled implemented and no new obligation is hidden by a placeholder. Inspected the current whole-file semantic_spec context (including the unrelated normalization-demand deferral clarification), current claim, metadata, and full test body; no helper code is called by this empty test and no additional production dependency is needed for this deferral assessment. Executed review start/read/record commands only; no behavioral suites were run by this reviewer, as execution is centralized by root. No source changes were made.
